tokens.name: Auth0 refresh token
tokens.purpose: Server-only. Mints new Auth0 access tokens. Not the browser host_access_token.

tokens.name: Auth0 access token
tokens.purpose: Server-only Auth0 API token. Not the host JWT in browser memory.

tokens.name: host_session_reference
tokens.purpose: Pedagogical host id. Not sent to Auth0 or Looker.

tokens.name: host_access_token
tokens.purpose: Host BFF JWT. Gates /api/looker/* and /api/lab/*. Not Auth0 access and not Looker api_token.

tokens.name: session_reference_token
tokens.purpose: Looker embed session identity. Server only; stripped from JSON to the browser.

tokens.name: authentication_token
tokens.purpose: Single-use bootstrap for /login/embed. Not the host JWT.

tokens.name: navigation_token
tokens.purpose: Page/dashboard navigation inside the embed iframe. Independent JWT clock from api_token.

tokens.name: api_token
tokens.purpose: Looker API calls the iframe makes (queries, data). Independent JWT clock from navigation_token.

methods.where_after: Query string on GET /callback for a few seconds. Not stored.
failure_modes: redirect_uri not in Auth0 Allowed Callback URLs
PKCE verifier missing from the oauth_pkce_state cookie

methods.where_after: All three stay on the HostSession. Browser never sees them. host_session_id cookie is set as the opaque handle.
failure_modes: offline_access not allowed → no refresh token

methods.where_after: Server HostSession. Rotating refresh tokens replace the stored value.
failure_modes: Reuse Detection if rotation is on and an old refresh is replayed

methods.where_after: JSON body → browser memory. This is the host BFF JWT, not Auth0 access and not Looker api_token.
JSON body → browser memory. Previous host_access_token jti is dead.
JSON to browser memory. session_reference_token is stripped and stored on HostSession only.
Looker holds the real session. Host keeps session_reference_token. Browser gets the other three.
failure_modes: Embed JWT Secret reset (kills all cookieless sessions)

methods.method: iframe navigation to embed login URL
methods.where_after: authentication_token is consumed (dead). navigation_token stays on the embed URL as embed_navigation_token.
No tokens travel. This is a request that the host must answer with session:tokens.
failure_modes: host ignores the message → iframe waits then errors

methods.where_after: Looker UI in the iframe. navigation_token is in-iframe page/dashboard navigation; api_token is iframe Looker API calls. First reply after login reuses acquire tokens; later replies need generate_tokens. Each JWT keeps its own exp.
failure_modes: stale tokens if refresh was frozen

methods.where_after: JSON to browser, then postMessage into the iframe. Server loads session_reference_token itself — the body is not trusted as a source of session identity.
failure_modes: freeze toggle on → tokens are not rotated

methods.where_after: session_reference_token stays on the server. New nav/api tokens returned to the browser without the reference.
failure_modes: ttl == 0 is wrapped as HTTP 409 code SESSION_DEAD

methods.where_after: Looker session deleted. Host copy of Layer B tokens cleared. Layer A remains.
failure_modes: already deleted (404 is treated as success for the lab)

methods.where_after: HostSession deleted. Cookie cleared. Auth0 refresh revoked when possible. Browser memory discarded.
failure_modes: Auth0 revoke endpoint unavailable — session is still deleted locally
Looker delete 404 if session already expired
